item.title: Bitcoin's Record Streak Nobody Wants
item.description: Bitcoin is edging toward a first in its 18-year life: two calendar years in a row that end in the red. Decrypt flagged the pattern this week, and the numbers show how narrow the gap to avoiding it still is.
